info.title: TechBridge Phase 8 Opportunity Management
info.description: Backend-only additive saved/history/eligibility APIs and improvements to existing discovery/application contracts. Public result lists are now bounded; arrays and legacy score fields remain. Actual account/token/provider/email checks apply to protected routes. No production migration or frontend source change.

get.description: Public, literal search. Only open, unwithdrawn, strictly future-deadline listings owned by currently active verified providers. Identity filtering precedes pagination; no provider private fields. Logical expiration causes no global write.

post.description: Current verified provider only; supported current service rechecked under the provider lock. Creator-owned source, revision zero. Conditional type fields are mandatory. No implicit scholarship award.

get.description: Public scholarship-only search using the same current-source and privacy checks; default earliest deadline.

get.description: Owning verified provider only. Effective expired status is computed without global writes. Batched application counts, including retained closed sources.

Student only, honoring enrolled email verification. Preserve 60/25/15 weights and original score fields; explicit aliases, distinct skill identity, blank/duplicate cleanup. Stream all filtered candidates in batches of 100 and retain only global top page*limit up to 5000; deterministic score/createdAt/ID order. Full candidate scoring remains O(catalogue), not AI.

get.description: Current student only. Saved rows remain paginated when sources expire/disappear/withdraw; unavailable opportunity is null and no private replacement terms are leaked. No peer saved counts.

put.description: Current student only. Empty body; unique student/source, idempotent initial timestamp, max 500 saved entries. Transactional owner/source revalidation. Mandatory application eligibility need not be met to bookmark.

delete.description: Current student only, empty body. Idempotent removal even after source deletion, using the same owner lock as pending reminder delivery.

get.description: Current student only; source must be currently public. Formal listing requirements or existing scholarship policy, advisory rule match, alreadyApplied and canApply. Preferred skills alone never block applying. No decision, award, evidence disclosure or fake application is created.
Public currently visible source only; existing targeted views counter increments. Closed/draft/expired/withdrawn or inactive-provider sources return 404.

put.description: Current verified owner and supported service rechecked inside transaction. Optional expected revision, explicit deadline handling, frozen mandatory requirements/type after applications, and existing scholarship term/capacity guard.

delete.description: Verified owner only. Ordinary source with applications closes and remains reachable for history; retained true. Empty sources may be removed. Existing scholarship retention policy is preserved.

post.description: Student's current data, source availability and provider authorization rechecked inside transaction. Enforces explicit ordinary eligibility, unique pair, actual initial history and outbox atomically. Scholarship submission uses its existing policy service.

patch.description: Actual source owner only; current provider revalidated. Ordinary transition, optional expected revision, current student eligibility for acceptance, atomic real history and notice. No stale or repeated extra event. Scholarship policy/capacity restrictions preserved.

get.description: Applicant or actual provider owner only; admins have no shortcut. Ordinary real journal or bounded scholarship status-event adapter. Incomplete legacy history is marked rather than reconstructed. Evidence references, private policy snapshots and override metadata are excluded.

Publish.description: Conditional type fields are validated by the existing publication contract. Expired is server-derived and cannot be supplied. Scholarship eligibility uses the scholarship policy API. Unknown fields are ignored; providerId/revision cannot be supplied to creation.

Edit.description: Partial owner edit. Optional expected revision detects stale writes. Type and mandatory eligibility freeze after the first application. Closing a past-deadline source is allowed; opening/draft requires future deadline. Scholarship award/term guards remain active.

Decision.description: Ordinary statuses: applied to reviewed/accepted/rejected; reviewed to accepted/rejected; accepted to reviewed/rejected; rejected to reviewed. Reopening a decided application requires reason. Repeats are idempotent; supplied stale revision is rejected. Scholarship-specific policy still applies and waitlisting is scholarship-only.

Error403.description: Role, account, ownership or current verification restriction

Error409.description: Duplicate, stale revision, eligibility, quota or frozen terms conflict

Error503.description: Infrastructure unavailable; no partial transactional domain change
